user.title: Connect to Contact Energy
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use for the Contact Energy app.

data_description.fetch_history: Imports every hour of usage the account has into the Energy dashboard. It is fetched gradually in the background (about 48 days per hour). When off, only the last 35 days are fetched.

contract.title: Select the electricity connection
contract.description: This login has several electricity connections (ICPs). Choose the one to add; add the integration again for the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Contact Energy rejected the password for {email}.

data_description.fetch_history: When off, only the last 35 days are fetched.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Contact Energy.

abort.already_configured: This electricity connection is already configured.
abort.no_electricity_contracts: This login has no electricity connection.

init.title: Gas rates
init.description: Contact Energy does not publish gas prices, so enter the rates from your bill (including GST) to get a gas cost for the Energy dashboard. A change applies from this month on; earlier months keep their rate. Leave both empty for no gas cost.

data_description.gas_price: Per kWh, e.g. 0.11362 for 11.362 cents per kWh.
data_description.gas_daily_charge: Fixed charges per day, e.g. the daily charge plus the Gas Industry Company fee. Leave empty to count only usage.
